'''Tarfful''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] and [[General/Legends|General]] who was an old friend of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and fought in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], at least until the battle ended during the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. During the battle in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he had good relations with [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and was behind him for the entirety of the battle. He carefully planned out the placement of troops and warriors with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. Vos also led the charge with both him and Chewbacca.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Tarfful went through his [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|hrrtayyk ceremony]] in [[185 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventures: Chewbacca and the Slavers of the Shadowlands">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Chewbacca and the Slavers of the Shadowlands]]''</ref> He eventually became the leader of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] and served for decades. He did not let his role in politics affect his warrior's edge, as he stayed in shape by vigorous exercise and hazardous hunting trips.

===Rescue mission to Wasskah===
{{Quote|Make it quick, general. We're charging by the minute, and if my ship gets damaged it will cost you extra.|Sugi to Tarfful|<ref name="WH">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ramy_thrown-WH.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Tarfful throwing a [[Ramy/Legends|Trandoshan]] off of the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|floating fortress]].]]
Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out, Tarfful spent years fighting [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 13: Chewbacca">{{FactFile2014|13|CHE 1-6|Chewbacca}}</ref> Tarfful's friend [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was captured by a group of Trandoshans and taken to [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. There, the young Wookiee built a signaling device which sent a distress message to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Tarfful hired bounty hunters [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]] to transport him and a group of Wookiees to Wasskah aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Halo/Legends|''Halo'']]. There, they made quick work of the Trandoshans and rescued Chewbacca, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka]], [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]], and [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]].

===Delta Squad===
Shortly before the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], Tarfful went missing and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] assumed he was lost. He was in fact caught by Trandoshan slavers, who were backed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and was being held in one of their camps. Upon learning of this, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] tasked the elite [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] with a [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|mission]] to rescue Tarfful and stop the Separatists. They found that the slavers were going to hand him over to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] for interrogation. Learning of this and General Grievous' presence on Kashyyyk, Delta Squad battled through the camp to rescue Tarfful. After Tarfful managed to destroy one of the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] attempting to drag him to the [[General/Legends|General's]] ship, Delta Squad took down the guards, and escorted Tarfful to his men.

===Military life===
[[File:TarffulLongun-WOSW.png|thumb|right|180px|Tarfful wielding a Wookiee long gun.]]
As [[Wookiee Chieftain|leader]] of the city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], he oversaw the battle on a high observation deck alongside [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], his old friend, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

He had good relations with Yoda and served with him as his deputy general for the entirety of the battle. Tarfful carefully planned out the placement of troops and warriors with Jedi Masters [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. Vos also led the charge with both he and Chewbacca.

When the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2008 Basic Figure|pack=#26: Clone Trooper (41st Elite Corps)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW26clone41st.asp}}</ref><ref name="SWPM1">{{PocketModel|set=Order 66|cardname=41st Elite Corps AT-RT|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipo13c.jpg}}</ref><ref name="SWPM2">{{PocketModel|set=Order 66|cardname=41st Elite Corps BARC Speeders|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipo02a.jpg}}</ref> turned on the Jedi, Tarfful and Chewbacca helped Yoda to an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. He and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] plan was originally to get to the escape pod undetected, however almost immediately after they left the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] meeting hall, they were attacked by clone troopers, but they managed to silence them before they could send word that the two [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] had escaped to the rest of the 41st Elite. They tried hiding from the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] in a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] boat, but eventually, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] decided it was too risky.

[[File:Wookieegoodbye.png|thumb|left|250px|Tarfful and Chewbacca say goodbye to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].]]

Eventually, Tarfful, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] reached the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], which was hidden in the mountains. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] bid farewell to his friends before leaving [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] for good.

===Imperial slave===
A few months later, Tarfful was around when a group of six Jedi who had escaped [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], led by [[Olee Starstone]], came to Kashyyyk, looking for any of the three Jedi that had been there when Order 66 had been issued. Tarfful fought in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], but he was rounded up by the Empire and became a slave, destined to help build the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Tarfful_RotS.png|thumb|right|180px|Tarfful was a brave warrior and leader.]]
Tarfful was a fearsome fighter as witnessed by Delta Squad. Normally he was a calm and caring individual. Jedi Grand Master Yoda was a trusted friend of his.

Tarfful's fur varied in color from dark brown to beige on various sections of his body. He wore armor around his shoulders and chest, likely traditional Wookiee armor. He often carried a Wookiee bowcaster on his person.

==Skills and abilities==
The non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Wookiee was extremely strong in both his fighting ability and his strength. He had above average intelligence and speed, but low diplomacy.<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Tarfful (Wookiee Cheiftan)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73989/cid/5329719/2012-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-90-Tarfful|archivedate=20250907234931}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Tarfull wore two [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoliers]] cinched by a clan emblem piece located on his chest. Two decorative pauldrons sat on his shoulders, and his hair was banded by many precious rings.<ref name="RotS:TVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarfful was played by [[Michael Kingma]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']].

According to the ''Revenge of the Sith'' DVD text commentary, during Yoda's "goodbye" scene to Chewbacca and Tarfful in the film, Tarfful's roar is actually [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Itchy's]] roar from ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.

The Tarfful Wookiee costume is on display at the ''[[Star Wars: Where Science Meets Imagination]]'' exhibit.
